about: Objects and animals of Creepyville, painted once and reused in every story. h = height in pixels when standing next to the hero (he is about 620 px tall).

rabbit.prompt: a small fluffy white rabbit sitting, long ears, big shiny eyes

black_cat.prompt: a sleek black cat sitting upright, glowing yellow eyes, tail curled

dog.prompt: a friendly scruffy brown dog sitting, floppy ears, red collar

crow.prompt: a black crow standing, head tilted, beady eye

owl.prompt: a brown owl standing, huge round orange eyes

deer.prompt: a young deer standing side-on, looking at the viewer, soft brown fur

raccoon.prompt: a mischievous raccoon standing on its back legs, masked face, striped tail

frog.prompt: a small green frog sitting, big eyes

goat.prompt: a white goat standing side-on, little horns, staring

red_car.prompt: a small old red hatchback car, side view, headlights off

blue_car.prompt: a plain blue family car with no stickers and no writing, three-quarter view

police_car.prompt: a small-town police car, black and white, light bar on the roof, side view

school_bus.prompt: a yellow school bus, side view

ice_cream_van.prompt: an old pastel ice cream van with a big cone on the roof, side view, slightly creepy

bicycle.prompt: a red bicycle with a basket, side view, standing on its kickstand

skateboard.prompt: a skateboard with stickers, side view

school_bag.prompt: a blue school backpack standing upright, slightly open

suitcase.prompt: an old brown leather suitcase standing upright with a luggage tag

umbrella.prompt: an open black umbrella standing on its tip

lantern.prompt: an old metal oil lantern glowing warm orange

flashlight.prompt: a yellow flashlight lying on its side

teddy_bear.prompt: a worn teddy bear sitting, one button eye

creepy_doll.prompt: an old porcelain doll in a lace dress sitting, cracked cheek, smiling a little too much

red_balloon.prompt: a single shiny red balloon floating on a long string

pumpkin.prompt: a carved jack-o-lantern pumpkin glowing inside

mailbox.prompt: a rusty mailbox on a wooden post, flag up

trash_can.prompt: a metal outdoor trash can with a dented lid

shopping_cart.prompt: an empty supermarket shopping trolley, three-quarter view

traffic_cone.prompt: an orange traffic cone with white stripes

old_tv.prompt: an old boxy television on short legs, screen glowing with static

goose.prompt: A plump, aggressively confident white goose with an orange bill and unblinking beady eyes that radiates unwarranted menace.

garden_gnome.prompt: A chipped ceramic garden gnome with a pointy red cap, a curly white beard, and an unsettlingly smug grin that seems to shift when nobody is looking.

possum.prompt: A scruffy, round-eyed opossum frozen completely stiff in a comical, overly dramatic 'playing dead' pose.

vending_machine.prompt: A humming retro snack vending machine casting a sickly green fluorescent glow, filled with suspiciously mysterious glowing soda cans.
